intro.note: Answer each question in your workbook. Show your working.
methodSteps: 2  Collect like terms on each side
3  Move the smaller letter term across
commonMistakes: A negative outside flips both signs inside.
Do not divide before expanding when other terms are present.
Watch signs when subtracting a bracket, e.g. − 2(x − 4) = − 2x + 8.
intro.visualAid: Area model: a rectangle split into 3 lots of (x + 2). The total area 3x + 6 equals 18, so each x = 4.

questions.content: Rectangle length (x+5), width 3, perimeter 28 cm. a) Equation. b) Find x. c) Area.
